name: consolidation
description: Memory consolidation and anti-forgetting. The hardest unsolved problem in continual learning. This module prevents catastrophic forgetting when learning new things by protecting important old knowledge.

methods.name: elastic_weight_consolidation
methods.description: Penalize changes to parameters that are important for previously learned tasks

methods.name: progressive_nets
methods.description: Allocate new capacity for new tasks while freezing old pathways

methods.name: episodic_replay
methods.description: Periodically replay old experiences during new learning

methods.name: knowledge_distillation
methods.description: Periodically distill learned knowledge into a compact representation

forgetting_detection.description: Alert if performance on any previously mastered task drops by >5%

capacity_monitoring.description: Alert if total parameters grow beyond 2x the base model

sleep_consolidation.description: Periodic offline consolidation phase (analogous to sleep). Replays, reorganizes, and compresses memories.
